summary: The note describes the Barton Government, the first federal Executive Government of the Commonwealth of Australia. It was led by Prime Minister Sir Edmund Barton from 1 January 1901 until 24 September 1903. Barton resigned in that year to become one of the three founding judges of the High Court of Australia.
one_line: The Barton Government was Australia's first federal executive government, led by Sir Edmund Barton from 1901 to 1903.
key_facts: The Barton Government was the first federal Executive Government of the Commonwealth of Australia.
The Barton Government was led by Prime Minister Sir Edmund Barton.
The Barton Government was in office from 1 January 1901.
The Barton Government ended on 24 September 1903.
Sir Edmund Barton resigned as Prime Minister on 24 September 1903.
Sir Edmund Barton resigned in order to become one of the three founding judges of the High Court of Australia.
